records.source_statement: Another subsection asks whether a married woman has another relationship besides her husband.
First house/lord, Moon and Moon's separating planet are given as the husband's significators when he asks.
limitations: Do not confuse first/7th allocation when wife asks herself.

records.source_statement: Seventh house/lord and Moon's applying planet signify the wife within that subsection.
limitations: Source gendered role allocation, not independent identity inference.

records.source_statement: Moon and seventh lord joining first lord or relevant reception is treated as a favourable relationship indication.
limitations: Must include reception/house terms; original text also warns practitioner to be careful.
